description: Bulk update multiple conversations. Each entry sets conversationStatus (ACTIVE, ARCHIVE, DELETE, READ, UNREAD) for a conversationId.

conversationId.description: The unique identifier of the conversation

conversationStatus.description: The updated status: ACTIVE, ARCHIVE, DELETE, READ, UNREAD

conversationType.description: The existing type: FROM_MEMBERS or FROM_EBAY (required but cannot be updated)

name: ebay_bulk_update_conversation
